def taller_within(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    n = len(a)
    result = [0] * n
    if k == 0:
        return result

    rank = {value: i for i, value in enumerate(sorted(set(a)), 1)}
    m = len(rank)
    bit = [0] * (m + 1)

    for i, value in enumerate(a):
        if i > k:
            pos = rank[a[i - k - 1]]
            while pos <= m:
                bit[pos] -= 1
                pos += pos & -pos

        r = rank[value]
        pos = r
        less_or_equal = 0
        while pos > 0:
            less_or_equal += bit[pos]
            pos -= pos & -pos

        result[i] = min(i, k) - less_or_equal

        pos = r
        while pos <= m:
            bit[pos] += 1
            pos += pos & -pos

    return result
